about: Every venue the Show Shack covers, in one place. The daily refresh routine sweeps the venues checked longest ago (null = never) and writes back lastChecked, calendar and how. Add a venue here and the refresh picks it up.

venues.name: Acrisure Arena
venues.how: acrisurearena.com and gametime.co are network-blocked in this session; WebSearch snippets of acrisurearena.com/events/detail/<slug> pages worked

venues.name: Agua Caliente Casino
venues.how: fetch blocked; WebSearch for 'The Show Agua Caliente 2027' surfaces ticketmaster venue page + eventticketscenter/stereoboard dated listings

venues.name: Backstreet Art District
venues.how: WebSearch only (WebFetch blocked). Visit Palm Springs + gaydesertguide list 1st Wed 5-7 PM year-round, free; district's FB/IG @backstreetartdistrict is the live source.

venues.name: Dave & Buster's
venues.how: Only third-party evidence (countrydancingtonight roundup: Mon 6-10 PM, free lessons, DJ); nothing on daveandbusters.com. Unverified for late 2026; low confidence.
